name: Solar photovoltaic installers
oneLiner: Physical work in a place that changes every day, on a roof that does not read specifications.
why: Every site is different: roof pitch, timber, weather, wiring
Fine motor control and safety judgement on ladders and live arrays
The energy transition is the demand driver, not AI
threats: Robotics, if dexterity and cost change, is the only real threat here
Pay is moderate for outdoor, hazardous work

claims.text: Second-fastest-growing occupation in BLS projections to 2035, at 36.5%.

Climate and energy-storage trends put renewable energy and environmental engineering roles among the fastest-growing, and environmental stewardship entered the top-10 fastest-growing skills for the first time.
